crossrefs.text: His descendants will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
The words of a manʼs mouth are deep waters; the fountain of wisdom is a bubbling brook.
to promiscuity, wine, and new wine take away understanding.
They are ever generous and quick to lend, and their children are a blessing.
Do not get drunk on wine, which leads to reckless indiscretion. Instead, be filled with the Spirit.

These also stagger from wine and stumble from strong drink: Priests and prophets reel from strong drink and are befuddled by wine. They stumble because of strong drink, muddled in their visions and stumbling in their judgments.
I will give them one heart and one way, so that they will always fear Me for their own good and for the good of their children after them.
It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, or for rulers to crave strong drink,
He who affixed the ear, can He not hear? He who formed the eye, can He not see?
Laziness brings on deep sleep, and an idle soul will suffer hunger.
This is why I speak to them in parables: ‘Though seeing, they do not see; though hearing, they do not hear or understand.’
But blessed are your eyes because they see, and your ears because they hear.
Surely there is no righteous man on earth who does good and never sins.
Do not let your zeal subside; keep your spiritual fervor, serving the Lord.
Idle hands make one poor, but diligent hands bring wealth.
The one who works his land will have plenty of food, but whoever chases fantasies lacks judgment.
Do not repay anyone evil for evil. Carefully consider what is right in the eyes of everybody.
Do not avenge yourselves, beloved, but leave room for Godʼs wrath. For it is written: “Vengeance is Mine; I will repay, says the Lord.”
Make sure that no one repays evil for evil. Always pursue what is good for one another and for all people.
Do not say, “I will do to him as he has done to me; I will repay the man according to his work.”
If anyone returns evil for good, evil will never leave his house.
Do not repay evil with evil or insult with insult, but with blessing, because to this you were called so that you may inherit a blessing.
Vengeance is Mine; I will repay. In due time their foot will slip; for their day of disaster is near, and their doom is coming quickly.”
When they heaped abuse on Him, He did not retaliate; when He suffered, He made no threats, but entrusted Himself to Him who judges justly.
For who among men knows the thoughts of man except his own spirit within him? So too, no one knows the thoughts of God except the Spirit of God.
I know, O LORD, that a manʼs way is not his own; no one who walks directs his own steps.
A manʼs heart plans his course, but the LORD determines his steps.
For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it pierces even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow. It judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
Nothing in all creation is hidden from Godʼs sight; everything is uncovered and exposed before the eyes of Him to whom we must give account.
Who is the man who fears the LORD? He will instruct him in the path chosen for him.
But there is a spirit in a man, the breath of the Almighty, that gives him understanding.
The steps of a man are ordered by the LORD who takes delight in his journey.
